svg.title: Headline numbers
svg.desc: 97 API endpoints, built solo (MyOrders · shipped in 2 weeks); 75% API latency cut (400 → 100 ms with Redis); 8.54 CGPA (B.Tech CSE · VIT Vellore); 3+1 papers + patent (IEEE · INCONSYM · ICICT)
